fields.System.Title: FDN-601 — Create a product
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want to create a product with its identity and physical
attributes, so that stock of it can be received, stored, and shipped.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a SKU, description, base UoM, weight, and dimensions, when I create a product,
  • then it is created with status draft and a generated internal ID.
  • - Given the created product, then product_id and sku are separate fields and the ID
  • is never derived from the SKU.
  • - Given a duplicate SKU, then it is rejected.
  • - Given a weight or dimension outside a plausible range, then it is rejected.
  • - Given a description that is blank or a placeholder such as "TBC", then it is rejected.
  • - Given a similar existing description, then a possible-duplicate warning is returned.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | product |
| Risks | SKU as a technical key ([doc 03 §7.2](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); duplicate products ([doc 03 §7.5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
